subject: MAP: evidence sequencing & DPA carve-outs for ClearVault pilot
messages:
From: Sam Dutton <sam.dutton@finview.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T13:12:00Z
Subject: MAP kickoff — evidence sequencing & DPA carve-outs for ClearVault PoC

Hi Kimberly / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — ClearVault’s security team asked me to get a short mutual action plan in place so we can scope the evidence intake and get the PO over the line. I attached our current MAP draft (ClearVault_MAP_v0.2.pdf) with the items they flagged as blockers. High-level asks from them:

- SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 Type I + roadmap to Type II) scoped to hosted API endpoints used by the PoC.
- Completed SIG/CAIQ questionnaire (they prefer a completed spreadsheet + a short attestation).
- Signed DPA with an explicit data retention window and a carve-out for backups (they want backup retention <= 180 days and an ability to confirm deletion).
- Confirmation on data residency for backups (EU vs US) and whether KMS-managed keys are used for backup encryption.

We need to agree sequencing/timing so ClearVault can schedule their internal risk committee and Procurement. Proposed rough timeline from their side: evidence intake week of May 3, legal DPA sign by May 14, and PO execution by May 21. Can the Redwood team commit to that cadence?

Attachments: ClearVault_MAP_v0.2.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Dutton
Head of Platform, FinView (on behalf of ClearVault PoC)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sam Dutton <sam.dutton@finview.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T17:40:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence sequencing & DPA carve-outs for ClearVault PoC

Hi Sam — thanks, and appreciate the clear asks. We can run to the timeline as long as a few gating clarifications are agreed up front. I captured a proposed sequencing below and attached an evidence matrix to make intake deterministic.

Proposed sequencing (high level):
1) Day 0–3: Redwood provides SOC 2 report package (scope statement + auditor letter) and CAIQ answer sheet. If we cannot provide a recent Type II, we will provide the latest Type I plus our Type II audit start date and remediation plan.
2) Day 4–10: Legal redline DPA. We will prioritize the backup retention clause and provide a clarification appendix that defines which artifacts live in backups vs ephemeral caches.
3) Day 11–17: Evidence intake sprint — our security engineering team will run 90-minute intake sessions (2–3 sessions depending on depth) and upload artifacts to the shared intake folder.
4) Day 18–21: Final signoff window and legal/finance PO.

Key Redwood confirmations we need from ClearVault to lock dates:
- Exact retention window for production backups vs PoC data (you asked for <= 180 days — is that a hard requirement?).
- Data residency requirement for backup storage (EU-only vs prefer EU).
- Whether ClearVault requires HSM/KMS attestation for keys used to encrypt backups.

I attached an initial Evidence Matrix: evidence_matrix.xlsx (XLSX) — it maps items (SOC2 control IDs, CAIQ categories, DPA exhibits) to a single owner and an expected delivery date. If you can confirm the retention residency answers above by EOD Monday we’ll lock resources for an intake sprint the week of May 3.

Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Attachments: evidence_matrix.xlsx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sam Dutton <sam.dutton@finview.com>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence sequencing & DPA carve-outs for ClearVault PoC

Hi all,

Quick operational clarifications from the security onboarding side that will affect sequencing:
- SOC 2 scope: our standard SOC 2 covers the hosted inference API and control plane. If ClearVault intends to use a private/on-prem deployment in the PoC, we need to explicitly call that out (different evidence set).
- Backup residency: we can isolate backups to EU regions for ClearVault (we already do for several customers), but there is an operational lead time of ~5 business days for the snapshot workflow and vault provisioning.
- Retention mechanics: we will provide a Data Retention Matrix that codifies retention periods, deletion flow, and deletion verification timestamps. Sample provided: data_retention_matrix.csv (CSV). Deletion verification will be via a signed attestation from our infra team within 3 business days of the deletion job.

On the SIG/CAIQ: we can provide a completed CAIQ export (CSV) and a short attestation letter. If the customer wants a self-hosted CAIQ review session, we can schedule one 60-minute walkthrough during the intake sprint.

If ClearVault confirms EU residency + 180-day backup retention is acceptable, we’ll target the intake sessions May 4–6 and push the DPA redline turnaround to May 11.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
From: legal@clearvault.com <legal@clearvault.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Sam Dutton <sam.dutton@finview.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearvault.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — evidence sequencing & DPA carve-outs for ClearVault PoC

Hi Kimberly / Sam,

Thanks for the sequencing. A couple of specific requests from Legal before we start the intake:
1) The DPA must include an explicit carve-out that backups are retained for a maximum of 180 days and that Redwood provides deletion verification upon request. Please provide the exact deletion verification template you will use (a short statement + timestamp + operator id).
2) We need confirmation that backups for the PoC can be provisioned in the EU region only (we currently have EU residency requirements for the pilot). If the live backups will be in the US, we will need a different data flow.
3) Please provide a link to the DPA DocuSign so we can circulate internally (we prefer a short form DPA with limited exhibits).

For transparency, our procurement timeline is tight — if we can get the DPA signed by May 11 and the intake evidence by May 6, we can complete PO approvals by May 18. If any of these change, flag us immediately.

Sam / ClearVault Legal —

Thanks for the calls and the clarity. Per Neha’s note we can confirm the following commitments for the PoC:

- SOC 2: we will provide the most recent SOC package we have. If Type II is not available before the PoC intake we will provide Type I + audit timeline and commit to a Type II audit kickoff within the next quarter.
- CAIQ: completed export + brief walkthrough during intake.
- DPA: we will publish a short-form DPA with the backup carve-out as an exhibit. I have initiated the DocuSign powerform (link below) and asked Legal to prioritize the redline.

Mutual Action Plan (finalized milestones):
- May 5: Redwood confirms EU backups + retention (this email).
- May 6–7: Evidence intake sessions (2 x 90m).
- May 11: DPA signature via DocuSign.
- May 14–18: Procurement final PO and account provisioning.
